Australia Cricket Team Faces Squad Changes After Loss to Bangladesh

Australia's cricket team is making squad changes for the second Test against Bangladesh following a historic nine-wicket defeat in the first match in Darwin. Opening batter Jake Weatherald has been dropped from the squad. Matt Renshaw has been recalled to the team. Australia captain Pat Cummins indicated a review of the batting performance is likely. The loss to Bangladesh, their first ever against the team in Australia, has also led to discussions about potential World Test Championship point deductions and a fine.
